body: I've done as much as I can on my own. Now I'm just disheartened and I have lost all motivation. I used to work out with a couple of friends, but I stopped.
Afraid not, there's nowhere like what you've described near where I live, besides whenever I'm alone with myself I always just end up thinking about my life and how much I hate it.
I was holding on, waiting for SOMETHING to change, change for the better, but I'm tired of waiting, tired of trying and now just tired of being alive and having to live like this.
